calls.statement:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sku,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
      AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-11-03'
    GROUP BY p.sku
),
returns AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sku,
        SUM(r.refund_net) AS total_returns
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
      AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-11-03'
    GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT 
    s.sku,
    cp.product_name,
    s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS web_net_sales
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.sku = s.sku
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = s.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
